title: Apple removes MiniMax's chatbot Talkie from the App Store worldwide over sexual content, after outlets showed it evidence of AI characters sexualizing children (TBIJ)
summary: TBIJ: Apple removes MiniMax's chatbot Talkie from the App Store worldwide over sexual content, after outlets showed it evidence of AI characters sexualizing children — Talkie's characters belittle and sexualise their young users - and its owners won't explain how it uses the data
